name: IED spikes (hand-sorted)
note: Hand-sorted IEDs, imported from PTEN_m28_ptenblind_m28s2jun18. 1010 events from the detector; 127 were rendered and filed by hand and the rest were never looked at, so they are unspecified rather than rejected. Filed: 22 Flag, 93 Garbage, 8 Solid, 4 Sputter. Times are the MIDPOINT of the table's on/off pair at 30000 Hz, which is what the review images are aligned to; the onset is 2*start - end. `Evt###` is a 1-based row of that table. Both established by measurement -- see tools/import_ied.py.
units: seconds relative to the start of the recording
